title: Rig Relay SearchReplace Invocation v1
description: Schema for a deterministic search_replace tool invocation request. Defines the bounded envelope for SEARCH/REPLACE block editing.

file_path.description: Path to the file to edit

content.description: One or more SEARCH/REPLACE blocks to apply

expected_before_sha256.description: sha256:<hex> of the file bytes before editing. Required for dirty files.

expected_replacements.description: Expected number of replacements. If set and actual count differs, returns count_mismatch without mutation.

allow_multiple.description: If false, multiple matches for the same search text return ambiguous_match without mutation.
